title: Get currently connected Wi-Fi network name
summary: Find out the name (SSID) of the Wi-Fi network your Mac is currently connected to.

aliases.text: what wifi am i connected to mac

steps.explain: Get the name of the currently connected Wi-Fi network. Replace <INTERFACE> with your Wi-Fi interface, usually en0 or en1.

placeholders.name: INTERFACE
placeholders.description: The Wi-Fi interface name, usually en0 or en1.

steps.expect: The SSID (name) of the connected Wi-Fi network.
